editorial.blurb: 336 Korean BBQ earns its stellar reputation with impeccably clean grills, attentive service that anticipates your needs, and meat so well-sourced it rivals Seoul itself.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for the grill to be swapped out proactively—they'll do it without being asked—and order the Dae Pae Samgyeop (thin sliced pork) and pork jowls, which regulars rave about as standouts.
